settings.caption: A real reply from Milo, chapter 03.
settings.heading: A mentor who asks the right question.
settings.text: Milo wrote the books, and Milo is there when you're stuck. It helps you find the answer. It never builds it for you.
Hi Milo, what does this chapter build?
This chapter is 03, The Noisemaker. It's about Act: making your machine loud enough that somebody in another room notices. Want to start with step 01, Open?

settings.title: Knows your page
settings.text: Built from the MakerNest books, so it knows your level and your chapter, and answers in words that fit.

settings.title: Hands you every sketch
settings.text: The code for each build comes from Milo. Copy it, run it, then change it and make it yours.

settings.title: Helps, never does it for you
settings.text: A question gets a better question, until you find the answer yourself. It won't give away a Break it answer.

settings.title: Grows with you
settings.text: From your first sensor in Origins to your own code and, in Autonomy, your first trained model.

settings.heading: Every page of the book has a door to Milo

settings.title: Type the link on the page
Say where you are
settings.text: Pick your step, so Milo knows what you've done.

settings.title: Get the sketch, or ask
settings.text: Copy the chapter's sketch, or tell Milo what's going wrong.

settings.title: Milo is a program, and says so.
settings.text: Ask it whether it's a person and it tells you it's an AI.

settings.title: No account, no personal details.
settings.text: Phone numbers and email addresses typed into Milo are removed before anything is stored.

settings.title: Kept for 7 days.
settings.text: Conversations are deleted after a week. Makers' words are never written to server logs.

settings.title: Stays on the bench.
settings.text: Milo talks about the chapter and the machine. Safety rules from the book always win.

settings.title: Points to people.
settings.text: If a maker sounds upset, Milo suggests a trusted grown-up, or Childline 1098 in India.
